    // The polygon with repeated vertices dropped. Does NOT make a polygon simple —
    // crossings are untouched — it removes the degeneracies that are removable without
    // changing the region.
    RemoveDuplicateVertices(p: Polygon2D): Polygon2D
        => Polygon2D(p.Points.RingWithoutDuplicateVertices);
